Male swelling uses separate anatomical evidence, not a hidden determination from this photograph.

shape.before: The withheld generic oval/rod-limbed draft and its concrete shortcomings remain shown in the comparison sheet.
shape.changed: A distinct quadrangular shell has three anterolateral teeth per side, a broad entire front and depressed posterolateral cues. Shorter pointed dactyli, spotted symmetrical palms, an adult-male membranous swelling and higher supported body/claw carriage replace the generic rod-legged body.
shape.remaining: Exact suborbital stridulatory crest, swelling contour, teeth, joint plates, mouthparts, gills and underside remain incomplete or unmeasured. The selected photo does not independently establish sex; the male swelling has separate morphological support. Band/spot positions, optics and wear remain approximate and stylized at fine scale.

surface.changed: Dark subtly varied shell, cream/red-spotted chelae, banded cuticle segments and pale ventral regions replace uniform brown. Numerical microrelief and sparse distal setae are original authored surfaces; no photo pixels are embedded.
surface.remaining: Original numerical illustration, not a scan, calibrated albedo, measured cuticle optics or full species variation. Exact suborbital stridulatory crest, swelling contour, teeth, joint plates, mouthparts, gills and underside remain incomplete or unmeasured. The selected photo does not independently establish sex; the male swelling has separate morphological support. Band/spot positions, optics and wear remain approximate and stylized at fine scale.

movement.changed: Same geometry and materials across a short authored lateral bout with planted support and lifted recovery, local chela/antennule handling, finger opening, quiet support and Observe reset. Eight pointed walking legs remain distinct from swimming paddles.
movement.remaining: No species-measured coordinates, biological frequency, joint limits, forces, fluid dynamics, sensory physiology, food contact or ingestion. No validated sleep, development, courtship or migration. Fixed-length/support tests are software consistency checks, not empirical biomechanics.

sourceAssessment: Naturalis institutional description based on T.Sakai1939 was directly read, including three side teeth, entire front, adult-male swelling and short dactyli. CIESM pigment description and the authentic Chuck Homler/Focus On Wildlife photo were compared. Smithsonian’s indexed NEMESIS account supplies identity/ecology context, not a collection determination. GBIF accepted species concept checked.
fixesAfterRenderedReview: Raised supported body/eye carriage and lowered the chela orientation after front-view comparison.
Reduced coarse shell pigment and false radial dome folds, then replaced preliminary captures with42 final states.
